d:
Serah Farron from the Final Fantasy XIII takes it upon herself to teach the miniflans of the Sunleth Waterscape in the Year 400 AF what it means to coexist peacefully with humans, instead of just being little scoundrels pestering passerbys!

Will she accomplish this goal of hers, or will her rage-prone temper overwhelm her?

Super cute comic that is a WIP.

You can find my and other's AI GEN comics here as well:
